facts.value: Enters ShieldBreakDownU or ShieldBreakDownD through the shared collision callback path used by ShieldBreakFly and ShieldBreakFall. Normalizes GA_Air through ftCommon_8007D7FC, selects the motion with ftCo_80097570, installs it and requests shared down-impact processing through ftCo_800978D4.
facts.rationale: Canonical entry behavior and both actual consumers avoid unsupported anatomical or guaranteed-effect claims.

facts.value: On normal execution, normalizes grounding only when ground_or_air == GA_Air. Selects DownU iff the mapped HipN matrix component chosen by x2226_b0 is strictly positive, otherwise DownD; signed zero and unordered comparisons select D. Calls Fighter_ChangeMotionState with Ft_MF_KeepColAnimHitStatus | Ft_MF_SkipModel | Ft_MF_SkipMatAnim | Ft_MF_SkipColAnim, animation arguments 0,1,0 and final NULL, then calls ftCo_800978D4 unconditionally. There is no local timer, input test or x2226_b1 inversion.
facts.rationale: Exact branch boundaries, flags and ordering replace stronger reset-policy interpretations.

facts.value: Borrows gobj, obtains Fighter from user_data and uses ground state and a mapped HipN matrix predicate to choose normalization and the motion ID. The selected ID, literal flags, f32 animation arguments 0,1,0 and final NULL flow to Fighter_ChangeMotionState. The subsequent impact helper consumes floor normal for an atan2f angle, passing TopN and the angle address to efAsync_Spawn with kind 4 and effect 0x406. Kind 4 copies the float into a queued record and retains the joint pointer; continuous attachment is not established. Shared impact processing consumes velocity plus knockback velocity and weight, optionally uses surface sound/effect overrides, requests a large quake and calls ftCommon_8007EBAC(fp,9,0). No object or callback is stored locally by this entry.
facts.rationale: Preserves verified data flow while correcting attachment, optional-branch and final-argument overinterpretation.

facts.value: Implements entry and four shared callbacks for ShieldBreakDownU/D. Entry chooses the variant through ftCo_80097570's strict mapped-HipN matrix predicate. Anim advances valid DownU/D dispatch to matching StandU/D when ftAnim_IsFramesRemaining returns false; IASA is inert; Phys and Coll forward to common handlers. Both ShieldBreakFly and ShieldBreakFall collision paths use the entry.
facts.rationale: Complete TU purpose uses canonical variants and active integration, without assuming asset anatomy.
